description: Raw event records ingested from all ticketing platforms. One row per event per ingestion batch. Deduplication and standardisation happens in the Silver layer (silver_events). Consumed by: silver_events → gold_ticket_sales_daily, gold_event_performance, gold_regional_summary, gold_channel_performance.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the event, assigned by the source ticketing platform. Natural key — not globally unique across platforms until deduplicated in silver_events.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the event as supplied by the platform. Standardised to INITCAP in silver_events.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: Category of the event e.g. Concert, Sports, Theatre, Comedy. Standardised to INITCAP in silver_events. Used as a dimension in gold_event_performance.

fields.name: venue_name
fields.description: Name of the venue hosting the event. Standardised to INITCAP in silver_events.

fields.name: venue_city
fields.description: City where the venue is located. Standardised to INITCAP in silver_events.

fields.name: venue_country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the venue (e.g. US, GB, DE). Standardised to UPPER in silver_events. Used as a regional dimension in gold_regional_summary.

fields.name: event_date
fields.description: Scheduled date of the event. Cast to DATE in silver_events. Records with null event_date are filtered out in Silver.

fields.name: event_capacity
fields.description: Maximum number of attendees for this event. Used to compute sell_through_rate_pct in gold_event_performance.

fields.name: platform_source
fields.description: Name of the originating ticketing platform that emitted this record. Standardised to UPPER in silver_events. Joined to silver_platforms via platform_name in gold models.

fields.name: ingested_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when this record was written to BigQuery by the ingestion pipeline. Used as the incremental predicate in silver_events (3-day lookback window).
